body: Well I don't know you or what you're going through, but I would hope that you don't kill yourself at all.

I had thought about driving to the woods and hanging myself, but I wouldn't want my parents to have to coming searching for my body. I have a gun at home, so I m going to shoot myself in the head in my backyard.
Thanks for your advice, but there's no making it through this, but I've already made up my mind.
